title: Armenian Cathedral of Lviv

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain immediately south of the mapped cathedral wall beside the arcade courtyard. Threshold grade is approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap way 179437775 defines the native cathedral outline and way 166631763 locates the separately mapped belfry. The outline generalizes the east end and includes attached ranges. The visible apse and gallery shapes come from the courtyard photographs.
mapIdentity.scope: The 11-corner OpenStreetMap cathedral way 179437775 fixes the outer envelope. The attached western range follows the mapped polygon and the east apses and courtyard gallery follow the photographs.

note: Three CC0 Qualla originals from May 2016 distinguish the polygonal drum and its low cross-topped roof, the eastern stone apses and the open southern arcade. The generalized map outline sets scale and orientation. Roof joins, rear elevations and exact grades are approximate. The separate bell tower and other buildings are outside this model.
